excluded: Consumer AI tools outside corporate accounts

sampling.populationDescription: Forty in-scope AI initiatives across internal platforms and lifecycle states.
sampling.rationale: The fictitious sample covers every platform, all four risk tiers and both build-time and runtime evidence.
limitations: The sample is fictitious and does not establish statistical representativeness.
Consumer tools and statutory legal conclusions are outside scope.

evidenceRegister.title: Example portfolio review minutes
limitations: Outcomes were recorded for only part of the portfolio.

evidenceRegister.title: Example governance charter and RACI walkthrough
limitations: Run Authority was not formally approved.

evidenceRegister.title: Example platform inventory sample
limitations: Inventories were not reconciled across platforms.

evidenceRegister.title: Example identity standard and account sample
limitations: Shared service accounts remained in the sample.

evidenceRegister.title: Example data classification and connector walkthrough
limitations: Connector gates were not common across platforms.

evidenceRegister.title: Example tool allowlist sample
limitations: Coverage was low and provenance was inconsistent.

evidenceRegister.title: Example risk and Responsible AI assessment sample
limitations: Tiering and impact assessment were not integrated.

evidenceRegister.title: Example runtime dashboard and containment walkthrough
limitations: Correlation and quarantine were not end-to-end.

evidenceRegister.title: Example training and support process records
limitations: Discovery and support outcomes were not measured consistently.

strategyValue.confidenceRationale: A portfolio process was observed, but outcome baselines covered only part of the population.
strategyValue.coverageBasis: Seventeen of twenty-four sampled initiatives had a recorded business baseline.
gaps: Outcomes não são medidos de forma consistente
strategyValue.rationale: Ownership and portfolio review were defined, while consistent outcome measurement was not demonstrated.

operatingModel.confidenceRationale: Charter, RACI and walkthroughs supported the defined process, but Run Authority approval remained incomplete and no corroborating operating test was available.
operatingModel.coverageBasis: The walkthrough covered all central forums and four of five domain authorities.
operatingModel.rationale: Decision forums and responsibilities existed, but runtime containment authority remained incomplete.

registryLifecycle.confidenceRationale: Multiple inventory sources consistently demonstrated fragmentation and missing reconciliation.
registryLifecycle.coverageBasis: Eleven of twenty-four sampled initiatives appeared in a reconciled inventory view.
registryLifecycle.rationale: Inventories existed in isolated systems without a common lifecycle or reliable attestation.

identityAccess.confidenceRationale: Standards and account records were available, but the sample exposed shared identities.
identityAccess.coverageBasis: Fourteen of twenty-four sampled initiatives used a traceable workload identity.
identityAccess.rationale: Identity requirements were defined and partially implemented, without consistent least-privilege evidence.

dataConnectors.confidenceRationale: Classification policy was available, while connector implementation evidence was incomplete.
dataConnectors.coverageBasis: Twelve of twenty-four sampled initiatives had owner and classification for every connector.
gaps: Data contracts e connector gates não são comuns
dataConnectors.rationale: Policies existed, but operational data contracts and connector gates were not consistently demonstrated.

toolsMcp.confidenceRationale: Only local allowlists were available and the sample did not cover every tool chain.
toolsMcp.coverageBasis: Eight of twenty-four sampled initiatives had complete tool provenance and ownership records.
gaps: Tool provenance e kill switch não são padronizados
toolsMcp.rationale: Local controls existed without common registry, provenance, scopes or tested revocation.

riskResponsibleAi.confidenceRationale: Assessment records were observed, but triggers and tiering differed between teams.
riskResponsibleAi.coverageBasis: Sixteen of twenty-four sampled initiatives had both risk and impact assessment evidence.
gaps: Tiering e impact assessment não estão integrados
riskResponsibleAi.rationale: Risk and Responsible AI processes were defined but not integrated into one proportional release path.

evaluationsRelease.confidenceRationale: Evaluation reports existed for the sample, with inconsistent thresholds and regression depth.
evaluationsRelease.coverageBasis: Thirteen of twenty-four sampled initiatives had versioned evaluation and release records.
gaps: Thresholds e regression suites variam por equipe
evaluationsRelease.rationale: Evaluation and release practices were defined, while consistent measured execution was not demonstrated.

auditOperations.confidenceRationale: Dashboards and walkthroughs exposed fragmented correlation and incomplete containment paths.
auditOperations.coverageBasis: Twelve of twenty-four sampled initiatives linked material runtime signals to an accountable action.
gaps: Correlation e quarantine não são end-to-end
auditOperations.rationale: Operational signals existed, but action, containment and evidence continuity were not consistently connected.

adoptionSupport.confidenceRationale: Training and support records were available, but outcomes and discovery were only partially measured.
adoptionSupport.coverageBasis: Seventeen of twenty-four sampled initiatives had a published support path and owner.
gaps: Discovery e support outcomes não são medidos
adoptionSupport.rationale: Enablement and support processes were defined without consistent outcome and feedback evidence.

priorities.outcome: Formalizar Run Authority e containment para agents state-changing.
Reconciliar registry e blueprints do escopo de produção.

comments: Low-confidence dimensions require additional evidence before investment decisions.
This review is not an audit, certification or independent assurance conclusion.

limitations: Exemplo fictício; não representa uma organização real.
Coverage e scores servem apenas para demonstrar o schema e o método.
Nenhuma conclusão jurídica, certificação ou assurance independente pode ser derivada deste arquivo.
